rows.qualification: BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree from an institution recognized by respective councils of that stream, plus completed compulsory internship at the time of submission of application, and registration certificate from the respective council. Must be able to read, write & speak in Bengali.

Graduation in Dental/Nursing OR Master degree in Life Science (Botany, Zoology, Human Physiology, Micro-biology, Biochemistry, Bio-technology, Bioinformatics)/Master Degree in Economics OR Graduation in Social Science with Master in Public Health/Preventive & Social Medicine OR Graduation in any discipline with MBA in Human Resource/Health Care AND efficiency in computers including MS office and internet. rows.experience: 2 years post qualification experience in the field of health programme management in diseases surveillance/community mobilization /Inter sectoral collaboration/IEC BCC activities /Quality Control/Monitoring and Evaluation

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Remuneration is fixed on a consolidated monthly basis: Rs. 32,000 for Medical Officer AYUSH (MHT) posts, Rs. 22,000 for Pharmacist under RBSK, and Rs. 35,000 for Public Health Manager under NUHM. Engagements are made purely on a contractual basis under the National Health Mission (NHM), Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal. The panel will remain valid for up to one year from the date of approval of DLSC.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHFWS Birbhum Medical Officer AYUSH (MHT) under RBSK
content_sections.text: Go to the official Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal website at http://wbhealth.gov.in and navigate to "On-line Recruitment". Register online using the prescribed format between 15 October 2026 11:00 AM and 4 November 2026 Midnight. Upload required scanned documents, photographs, and signatures carefully. Pay the application fee of Rs. 100/- for General candidates or Rs. 50/- for Reserved category candidates through net banking or credit/debit card online interface. Submit the online application form and download/retain the hard copy/print-out of the online registration form for future document verification purposes. Do not send hard copies by post.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Permanent residential proof of West Bengal Proof of local language knowledge (Bengali reading, writing, and speaking capability) Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (Class 10, Class 12, Graduation, Post-Graduation, Diploma, or Degree certificates as applicable) Compulsory internship completion certificate (for Medical Officer AYUSH posts) Registration certificate from the respective council (State Register of Homeopathic Medical Practitioners, West Bengal Pharmacy Council, etc.) Caste certificate issued on or before the last date of online application by competent authorities of West Bengal only (if claiming SC, ST, OBC, or EWS status) Disability certificate issued on or before the last date of online application by competent authorities of West Bengal only (for PwBD candidates) Experience certificate (for Public Health Manager post) Scanned photograph and signature

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced in DHFWS Birbhum Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 48 vacancies are announced across Medical Officer AYUSH (MHT) for Male, Medical Officer AYUSH (MHT) for Female, Pharmacist under RBSK, and Public Health Manager under NUHM posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for DHFWS Birbhum Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for registration, fee payment, and full form submission is midnight of 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the upper age limit for Medical Officer AYUSH (MHT) posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years as on 1st January 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the consolidated monthly remuneration for the Pharmacist under RBSK post?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 22,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is application fee required for reserved category candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, reserved category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 50/-, while General candidates pay Rs. 100/-.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualification is required for Pharmacist under RBSK?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Two years Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharma) (Allopathic) from any institute approved by Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)/AICTE and hold a registration certificate issued from the West Bengal Pharmacy Council.

faq.question: Q7. Who is eligible to apply in terms of residency?
faq.answer: Applicants must be permanent residents of West Bengal and must have knowledge of local languages (reading, writing, and speaking in Bengali).

faq.question: Q8. How can I submit my application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly online through the official web portal at http://wbhealth.gov.in under "On-line Recruitment". Hard copies should not be sent by post.
